about: The reader's recordings for the 一騎打ち call: one entry per file, its path under assets/, the card it reads (poem id) and the ms from the file's start at which each sound (kana) of the card's kimariji starts. A card with no entry is read at the even pace of IkkiuchiReaderTuning. Example entry: {"file": "voice/reader/001.m4a", "card": 1, "onsets": [180, 520, 860]}
